meta.tagline: Following the internet's favorite German World Cup fan as he road-trips across the United States and Canada.
meta.disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made tracker based on public posts and published reporting.

current.headline: Home after a 49-day North American road trip
current.detail: Freddy returned home on July 24 and has since announced plans for another U.S. road trip this fall centered on college football.

updates.title: A fall college-football road trip is in the works
updates.summary: Freddy announced plans to return to the U.S. in September or October for college football and other distinctly American events. The early wish list includes Oktoberfest in Helen, the State Fair of Texas, and the Breeders' Cup at Keeneland; no fixed route has been announced.

updates.title: Home sweet home
updates.summary: Freddy posted from home in Hamburg after the overnight trip back from the United States.

updates.title: So long, America
updates.summary: After 49 days, Freddy and the group headed to the airport and closed out the World Cup road trip with a farewell post.

updates.title: The road trip ends with a Washington VIP day
updates.summary: The final major stop included tours of the White House West Wing, the U.S. Capitol, Washington Monument, and other monuments, plus an all-American lunch. Freddy's Instagram Day 47 and Day 48 highlights preserved the visit.

updates.title: West Virginia becomes state number 25
updates.summary: The group crossed into West Virginia, the final new state of the trip, before turning toward Washington for the closing stretch.

updates.title: Mammoth Cave, Keeneland, and Lexington
updates.summary: Freddy explored Mammoth Cave, learned about horse racing during a behind-the-scenes visit at Keeneland, and ate locally in Lexington.

updates.title: Country music takes over the Nashville stop
updates.summary: The Tennessee leg included Ocoee, Nashville, the Country Music Hall of Fame, a Grand Ole Opry experience, and a last night on Broadway.

updates.title: A first MLS match in Nashville
updates.summary: Freddy attended Nashville against Atlanta for the group's first MLS game and received upgraded hospitality at the stadium.

updates.title: Clemson to Cherokee and the Smokies
updates.summary: The group continued from Clemson into the Great Smoky Mountains, stopped in Cherokee, North Carolina, and then turned toward Tennessee.

updates.title: Freddy returns to X from Clemson
updates.summary: After two weeks away, Freddy reactivated the account to document the last part of the road trip, saying supportive messages on Instagram convinced him to finish sharing it.

updates.title: Myrtle Beach, Charleston, Savannah, and Clemson
updates.summary: The coastal leg moved through Myrtle Beach and Charleston, then toward Savannah and Clemson. It included mini golf, a first Sonic visit, moss-covered streets, wildlife refuges, and an alligator sighting.

updates.title: Beaches, wild horses, and the Outer Banks
updates.summary: Freddy's quieter Instagram-only stretch included Delaware beaches, Chincoteague and Assateague, the Outer Banks, and a young black bear blocking the road in North Carolina.

updates.title: A Fourth of July in Washington
updates.summary: The group celebrated America's 250th birthday in Washington with the National Mall crowd, fireworks, and the holiday flyovers.

updates.title: Pennsylvania lakes, small towns, and Virginia
updates.summary: On the route south from New England, the group swam in Pennsylvania lakes, visited Jim Thorpe, Three Mile Island, and Harrisburg, then watched a local football game and pie-eating contest in Virginia.

updates.title: A Gordon Ramsay sendoff from Boston
updates.summary: The group's last Boston stop was lunch at Ramsay's Kitchen, where they tried New England specialties and received a video message from Gordon Ramsay after Germany's loss.

updates.title: The trip moves from X to Instagram
updates.summary: Freddy deactivated X after the conversation around the account became toxic, but said the road trip would continue and shifted daily updates to Instagram Stories.

updates.title: Germany exits, but the road trip continues
updates.summary: Paraguay eliminated Germany on penalties near Boston. With the flight home still scheduled for July 23, Freddy asked followers what the group should do next.

updates.title: Slammiversary and the Hardy Boyz
updates.summary: Freddy attended TNA Slammiversary in Boston and met childhood wrestling heroes Matt and Jeff Hardy.

updates.title: The road trip reaches Mount Washington
updates.summary: With the travel group temporarily down to two, Freddy reached the summit of Mount Washington, the highest peak in the northeastern United States.

updates.title: Slower roads through small-town Ohio
updates.summary: The group deliberately avoided the interstates, stopping in Elmore and Berlin, Ohio. Freddy called Berlin one of his favorite places on the trip and encountered Amish horse-drawn buggies.

updates.title: Lake Ontario and Niagara Falls
updates.summary: After the Toronto match, Freddy explored the Lake Ontario shore and Niagara Falls before beginning the long, scenic route toward Boston.

updates.title: Germany vs. Ivory Coast in Toronto
updates.summary: After the last-minute flight scramble, Freddy made it to Toronto for Germany's second World Cup match, a 2-1 win over Ivory Coast.

updates.title: American Airlines and J.J. Watt rescue the Toronto trip
updates.summary: A weather-canceled Dallas connection threatened to make the group miss Germany's match. After a burst of public offers, American Airlines found seats to Buffalo, with J.J. Watt helping behind the scenes.

updates.title: The Ella Langley meetup happens
updates.summary: Freddy's first country concert became a dream-come-true meetup with Ella Langley, the artist behind the road trip's soundtrack.

updates.title: Portugal vs. DR Congo in Houston
updates.summary: Freddy attended a second World Cup match in Houston to watch Cristiano Ronaldo and Portugal before the overnight drive to Oklahoma City.

updates.title: A private NASA day at Johnson Space Center
updates.summary: Freddy met astronauts, sat inside the Orion capsule that flew Artemis II, and connected with the International Space Station during a major Houston highlight.

updates.title: Houston hospitality keeps escalating
updates.summary: The group ate barbecue with Houston police, met Mayor John Whitmire at an Astros game, received another J.J. Watt surprise, and squeezed in a late Galveston visit.

updates.title: Germany opens with a 7-1 win
updates.summary: Freddy watched Germany beat Curaçao 7-1 in Houston in the group's first World Cup match of the trip.

updates.title: J.J. Watt delivers a serious Houston welcome
updates.summary: A stay at the Post Oak Hotel, local food, and a personalized Texans jersey were among the surprises arranged for Freddy and his friends.

updates.title: Freddy reaches Houston
updates.summary: The group drove into downtown Houston late Saturday after the long trip across the South.

updates.title: An Ella Langley meetup is reportedly on the schedule
updates.summary: After her music became the soundtrack of the trip, Freddy said the group had been given an opportunity to meet Ella Langley at her June 18 Oklahoma City concert.

updates.title: New Orleans and Baton Rouge
updates.summary: Freddy's route continued through Louisiana before the final push west to Houston.

updates.title: The American road-trip checklist keeps growing
updates.summary: Buc-ee's, Bass Pro Shops, Raising Cane's, Walmart, Chili's, Waffle House, and other stops became part of the viral travel diary.

updates.title: Jordan-Hare Stadium becomes a major viral moment
updates.summary: Freddy attended Argentina vs. Iceland in Auburn and reacted to the stadium and eagle flyover with full European-mind-can-not-comprehend energy.

updates.title: The Waffle House review takes off
updates.summary: A late-night Waffle House visit in Georgia earned a 10/10 and became one of the trip's breakout posts.

updates.title: Six weeks, hand luggage, and mostly jerseys
updates.summary: Freddy announced the start of a six-week World Cup trip through the United States and Canada.
